dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: Welcome! Care to peruse our goods?

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: My dear customer, when it comes to the things we sell here, the older, the better!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the stuff you sell here?

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: They are the fruits of adventure, trophies of the pioneering spirit.

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: Some are trinkets I picked up myself, while others were given to me. As for what you buy — well, that's up to you!

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: Of course, if you've got your eye on anything in particular, you can pay a deposit first, then take it over to the Saurian Relics Association for appraisal before you decide whether or not you want to buy it.

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: But as for how professional their opinion would be... Haha, well, that's hard to say. If you ask me, you'd be better off listening to a few more of my stories.

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: No worries. We can chat when you have some time on your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it really alright if I don't buy anything?

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: Of course, no problem at all. After all, what better advertisement could I ask for than having people being willing to hang around in front of my stall?

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: Thanks to this, I've also met quite a few colorful characters.

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: I remember one cool customer from Fontaine who wore sunglasses and a little anchor on his hat. He left quite the impression.

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: He didn't say much, but he was very curious about Natlan's Ancient Names. He listened to me rabbit on about them for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Echuah
dialogues.text: I'm sorry to say that I've completely forgotten everything I said then... Perhaps some of it wasn't particularly accurate either, haha.
